why: I checked both verifier checks against their expect lines. Check 2 is fine: requiring that README.md mention --tsv and say what it does is a fair reading of "documents --tsv". Check 1 asks for more than its line does. The line only requires that --tsv prints the same JSON array the CSV run prints for the same table. But its PASS condition also fixes the CSV output to an exact value: "the CSV output is a JSON array of row objects (for the first table, [{"name":"ann","age":"30","city":"paris"},...])". It also requires that "both commands exit 0", which covers the CSV-only run. The words don't force either of these. They test the existing CSV baseline and its exact output, not whether --tsv matches it. Those stricter tests belong under Advisory, not in the PASS condition.
